title: Mental Energy & Resilience Index
subtitle: Assess your current cognitive battery, recovery rhythm, and stress tolerance.

questions.text: How do you wake up on most weekdays?

options.text: Energized and mentally clear to tackle the day's challenges.
Decent; need a few minutes and a coffee to hit my stride.
Fatigued, dreading the upcoming list of obligations.
Exhausted, feeling like sleep did nothing to restore my brain.

questions.text: When an urgent surprise disrupts your schedule mid-day:

options.text: I pivot calmly and handle it without lingering distress.
I get slightly tense, but take a breath and re-prioritize.
I feel immediate irritation and like things are spiraling.
I feel like quitting; any new demand feels like an avalanche.

questions.text: How is your ability to focus on deep, demanding work lately?

options.text: High; entering flow state feels natural and sustained.
Good; occasional mild distractions, but easily managed.
Fickle; taking longer to engage and switching tabs constantly.
Very poor; re-reading the same sentence in a constant brain fog.

questions.text: Over weekends or days off, are you truly able to unplug?

options.text: Yes, I completely immerse in leisure and fully recharge.
Mostly, although occasional work thoughts pop into mind.
I struggle; I feel guilty resting or keep checking updates.
Impossible; I spend days off paralyzed with dread about Monday.

questions.text: Which quote best captures your pace over the past few weeks?

options.text: 'I am in the driver seat, building at a sustainable pace.'
'Things are intense, but I still have a steady hand on the wheel.'
'I am near the red line; if I don't slow down, something will snap.'
'I am running on autopilot out of pure survival mode.'

peak.title: Peak Battery: High Resilience
peak.description: Your cognitive reserve is stellar. You maintain mental clarity under fire and recharge with ease. Keep nurturing the lifestyle habits supporting this high-level state!

balanced.title: Stable & Sustainable Equilibrium
balanced.description: You balance life's daily demands with healthy psychological boundaries. While workload peaks happen, you possess good recovery habits to stay centered.

alert.title: Overload Warning
alert.description: Your mental battery is entering low-power mode. Mild irritability and focus lapses are early alarms. Renegotiate deadlines and protect non-negotiable rest intervals.

depleted.title: Depleted Battery: Immediate Rest Required
depleted.description: Your nervous system is waving a red flag. Brain fog and sensory fatigue mean pushing further yields diminishing returns. Slow down and prioritize recovery today.
